claim: The 2026-2035 cross-domain convergence thesis is not a scoreable composite forecast until its component domains, joint outcome, thresholds, and timing rule are specified
source_and_publication_date: Legacy local register read 2026-11-01; reviewed against sources in FORECAST_AUDIT.md
assumptions: A single convergence outcome would require compatible indicators and pre-registered thresholds across domains
mechanism: Cross-domain coupling is hypothesized but no aggregate model or causal estimates are supplied
quantitative_basis: No joint event definition, composite statistic, forecast distribution, or reproducible calculation exists in the legacy register
uncertainty_sensitivity: High; results depend on chosen domains, thresholds, lag structure, and whether signals are independent
invalidating_conditions: A dated rule that specifies domains, joint event, weights, thresholds, source series, and review cadence would make this scoreable; until then no outcome can be counted as a hit or miss
status: Unscored; retain as scenario framing only

claim: METR's time-horizon measure estimates success on tasks by human-expert task duration; it does not measure the duration an agent works independently or economy-wide automation
source_and_publication_date: METR Task-Completion Time Horizons page last updated 2026-09-08; limitations note 2026-01-22
assumptions: Task suite and human-duration estimates are relevant to the measured software, machine-learning, and cybersecurity task distribution
mechanism: Fitted success probability versus human-estimated task duration
quantitative_basis: METR says measurements above 16 hours are unreliable with its current suite; the page is no longer actively updated
uncertainty_sensitivity: Task selection, human baselines, benchmark saturation, task context, and domain coverage limit extrapolation; METR notes domain differences can be large
invalidating_conditions: A replacement or updated benchmark with different methods should be reported separately and not treated as a directly comparable point without a bridge
status: Definition and measurement limits verified; do not use as an autonomy or jobs forecast

claim: LEAP Wave 8 expert median for reaching its defined AGI event was 2050 conditional on a majority of its panel agreeing AGI exists before 2100; its 25th and 75th percentile years were 2039 and 2065
estimate_owner: LEAP respondents; not an own estimate
assumptions: AGI means a commercial system outperforming a 90th-percentile professional employee in every primarily non-physical occupation on at least 90% of economically useful non-physical tasks, with inference cost no more than 5x equivalent human labor
mechanism: No causal model; this is a distribution of respondents' judgments under the stated definition
quantitative_basis: 205 experts, 52 superforecasters, and 601 public respondents reported; expert conditional median year 2050, 25th percentile 2039, 75th percentile 2065
uncertainty_sensitivity: Conditional on a panel-majority declaration event before 2100; not an unconditional probability that AGI will arrive by 2050; definition differs from other surveys
invalidating_conditions: A materially revised definition, panel resolution rule, or later wave changes the comparable forecast
status: Use as a distinct conditional survey forecast; do not pool with other AGI dates

claim: The live Metaculus Q5121 page displayed a current estimate of 23 Sep 2030 and a displayed range of 22 Mar 2028 to Jul 2036
estimate_owner: Metaculus forecasters; not an own estimate
assumptions: Applies only to Q5121's resolution criteria; full criteria were not available in the extracted page text used for this audit
mechanism: Aggregation of crowd forecasts; no causal mechanism asserted
quantitative_basis: Displayed estimate 23 Sep 2030; displayed range 22 Mar 2028 to Jul 2036; page showed about 1.9k forecasters
uncertainty_sensitivity: The page did not label the statistical meaning of the displayed range in the extracted text; its definition is not interchangeable with LEAP's AGI definition
invalidating_conditions: A fresh page read may move the estimate; inspect the full resolution criteria before comparing to another AGI operationalization
status: Point-in-time forecast only; prior local description of its criteria is unverified

claim: The cited AGI-to-ASI paper defines AGI and ASI informally relative to human-level and broadly superhuman capability, and discusses pathways and bottlenecks rather than giving a dated ASI forecast
estimate_owner: Authors' conceptual analysis; no ASI date estimate
assumptions: Definitions are qualitative and the report explicitly notes uncertainty about the post-AGI transition
mechanism: Potential pathways include scaling, paradigm shifts, recursive improvement, and multi-agent collectives; possible frictions can slow or halt them
quantitative_basis: No numerical probability or date estimate reported in the cited source summary
uncertainty_sensitivity: High; a broad qualitative label does not operationalize a resolvable event
invalidating_conditions: A measurable ASI definition plus an elicited forecast and resolution protocol would be needed to score timing
status: Keep as a scenario map, not an ASI timeline

claim: RWA.xyz reported $39.17B distributed asset value and $398.06B represented asset value as of 2026-11-01; these are distinct metrics and do not by themselves establish liquid institutional settlement rails
assumptions: Use the provider's distributed and represented categories as labelled; do not merge either with stablecoins
mechanism: Token issuance and represented off-chain assets are different measurement concepts
quantitative_basis: Distributed asset value $39.17B; represented asset value $398.06B; stablecoin value separately shown as $286.62B
uncertainty_sensitivity: Provider definitions, asset coverage, valuation and liquidity differ; a value total is not evidence of secondary-market liquidity or system-wide adoption
invalidating_conditions: A provider methodology change or reconciled independent asset-level data would require a new comparison
status: Current values verified; legacy forecast FC-002 is not scored because its threshold and historical values were incomplete

claim: IMF COFER reported the U.S. dollar share of global foreign-exchange reserves at 56.70% in 2026Q2, down from 57.18% in 2026Q1
estimate_owner: IMF COFER; not an own estimate
assumptions: Shares are of reported allocated foreign-exchange reserves, not total global wealth or all reserve assets
mechanism: Currency portfolio shares change through transactions and valuation effects
quantitative_basis: World total reserves $13.22T in 2026Q2; dollar share 56.70%, versus 57.18% in 2026Q1
uncertainty_sensitivity: One quarterly change does not establish a persistent trend; the IMF said exchange-rate valuation effects were limited and other price changes or reallocations contributed
invalidating_conditions: A sustained reversal or revisions to COFER data would weaken the claim of ongoing decline
status: Latest release found in this review; no probability assigned to a 2030 threshold

claim: World Gold Council reported central-bank net gold buying of 39 tonnes in August 2026 and 170 tonnes year to date through August; 2026 full-year demand is not yet observed
source_and_publication_date: World Gold Council report published 2026-10-06; data through 2026-08-31 where available
estimate_owner: World Gold Council using IMF and central-bank reports; not an own estimate
assumptions: Reported net activity and WGC coverage define the series
mechanism: Reported purchases and sales by central banks
quantitative_basis: August net buying 39t; 2026 year-to-date reported purchases 170t through August; the WGC's full-year 2025 report recorded 863.3t
uncertainty_sensitivity: Reported coverage can lag and varies by central bank; incomplete-year totals are not annualized here
invalidating_conditions: Final 2026 series or revisions can change the year-to-date comparison; no full-year claim is made

claim: U.S. nonfarm business labor productivity grew 1.4% at an annualized rate in 2026Q2 and 2.2% from a year earlier; the release does not attribute this growth to AI
assumptions: The quarterly rate is seasonally adjusted and annualized; year-over-year rate is a separate comparison
quantitative_basis: Nonfarm business productivity +1.4% quarter-over-quarter annualized and +2.2% year-over-year
uncertainty_sensitivity: Quarterly values are revised; aggregate labor productivity does not identify AI's causal contribution; next preliminary release scheduled 2026-11-05
invalidating_conditions: Subsequent revisions or later quarters may change the series; an AI attribution requires separate causal evidence
status: Latest release available on review date

claim: CBO estimated the FY2026 federal deficit at $2.0T and projected debt held by the public from 100.6% of GDP in 2026 to 120.2% in 2036; its separate higher-rate values are sensitivity scenarios, not forecasts
source_and_publication_date: CBO Monthly Budget Review 2026-10-08; CBO higher-rate analysis 2026-10-08
source_type: External official estimate and conditional projections
assumptions: Baseline follows CBO assumptions; alternative cases change all interest rates relative to the February 2026 baseline
mechanism: Higher interest rates increase debt-service costs and projected deficits in the scenario analysis
quantitative_basis: FY2026 deficit $2.0T; baseline debt/GDP 100.6% in 2026 and 120.2% in 2036; CBO also examined +50bp and +150bp cases
uncertainty_sensitivity: The 50bp and 150bp cases are sensitivity scenarios, not assigned probabilities; debt and interest outcomes depend on CBO assumptions
invalidating_conditions: New CBO baseline or materially different fiscal outcomes require a fresh comparison
status: Fiscal pressure is documented; YCC or debt monetization is not established by these data

claim: Delayed-impact scenario: task capability improves but deployment and measured productivity effects lag because integration, reliability, energy, regulation, or organizational adaptation constrain diffusion
source_and_publication_date: Own scenario, informed by METR limitations and BLS productivity definitions, reviewed 2026-11-01
assumptions: Capability gains do not guarantee adoption or measured productivity gains
mechanism: Deployment depends on complementary infrastructure, workflows, trust, and investment
quantitative_basis: Track deployment by sector, task-level reliability, infrastructure constraints, and output-per-hour data; no threshold has been pre-registered
uncertainty_sensitivity: Timing depends on sector and measurement choices
invalidating_conditions: Strong cross-sector deployment and attributable productivity gains ahead of capability forecasts would weaken the delayed-impact scenario
status: Retain as alternative; set no probability

claim: Partial-convergence scenario: rapid progress occurs in selected digital tasks or financial rails while physical-world deployment, reserve shifts, or institutional change remain uneven
source_and_publication_date: Own scenario, informed by METR, IMF COFER, RWA.xyz, and BLS, reviewed 2026-11-01
assumptions: Domain measures have different definitions and adoption paths
mechanism: Different technical, institutional, and market frictions prevent synchronized transitions
quantitative_basis: Report each domain series separately; do not average task horizons, reserve shares, asset values, and productivity into one score
uncertainty_sensitivity: High cross-domain heterogeneity; represented asset value and task benchmark scores are not common units
invalidating_conditions: Repeatedly synchronized, independently measured changes across the pre-registered domains would weaken the partial scenario
status: Retain as alternative; set no probability

claim: Non-convergent scenario: capability growth plateaus or its economic diffusion stays limited, while macro-financial indicators evolve through ordinary policy and market adjustment rather than a common crisis mechanism
source_and_publication_date: Own scenario, reviewed 2026-11-01 against cited official and benchmark series
assumptions: No unmeasured structural break is assumed
mechanism: Scaling limits, weak adoption, or policy responses dampen cross-domain coupling
quantitative_basis: Track benchmark updates, adoption, productivity, CBO baselines, COFER, gold purchases, and distributed RWA values separately
uncertainty_sensitivity: A lack of a common event definition prevents aggregate sensitivity analysis
invalidating_conditions: Sustained broad capability gains, verified adoption, and cross-domain causal effects would weaken this scenario
status: Retain as alternative; set no probability

claim: Rapid-coupling scenario: capability growth, broad deployment, fiscal or institutional strain, and financial-rail adoption reinforce one another; this remains a conditional scenario, not the base case
source_and_publication_date: Own scenario; source-grounded indicators from METR, LEAP, CBO, IMF, WGC, BLS, and RWA.xyz, reviewed 2026-11-01
assumptions: Several independent domains would need to cross specified thresholds within a stated lag
mechanism: Possible feedback loops are hypotheses; no causal coefficients or joint distribution are estimated
quantitative_basis: Require pre-registered domain thresholds, dates, cross-impact directions, source series, and a reproducible sensitivity model before scoring
uncertainty_sensitivity: Very high; dependence, threshold, and lag assumptions dominate
invalidating_conditions: Failure to observe the pre-registered cross-domain links or a clear alternative causal explanation would weaken the scenario
status: Retain as a testable research scenario only; no probability assigned
